content.text: Commit the fix in sizes.py and push.
Git goes through the git tools, not run_shell. Status first, so the commit covers exactly what changed.

content.name: git_diff
content.text:
diff --git a/pkg/sizes.py b/pkg/sizes.py
--- a/pkg/sizes.py
+++ b/pkg/sizes.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def threshold(n):
-    return n
+    return n // 2
The change halves the threshold. `git_commit` stages that one path and commits it; the result carries an `undo` token in case the change has to come back out.

Ahead by one, behind by none: the push is a plain fast-forward for the remote.
